description: This is a C# source file that defines a static internal class 'XKnownColorTable' within the 'PdfSharp.Drawing' namespace. The class manages a table mapping known color enum values to ARGB color codes, providing methods to convert between colors and to query the table. The code is part of the PDFsharp library for PDF processing in .NET, specifically handling color recognition and conversion.

classes.name: XKnownColorTable
classes.description: A static class managing a table of known colors and providing methods for color conversion and recognition.

methods.name: KnownColorToArgb
methods.description: Converts an XKnownColor enum value to its ARGB representation using the internal color table.

methods.name: IsKnownColor
methods.description: Checks if a given ARGB value exists within the known color table.

methods.name: GetKnownColor
methods.description: Retrieves the XKnownColor enum value corresponding to a given ARGB value, if present.
